finding.claim: A .claude/rules/<rule>.md that exists but is not a file (a folder) now crashes init with an IsADirectoryError traceback from path.read_bytes(); before this change it was kept. It should be skipped with a warning, the way an AGENTS.md that is not a file is.

fixes.change: _write_rules skips a rule path that exists but is not a file, with a warning, instead of crashing on read_bytes.
